name: voxelize_matrix
description: DRAW a shape as a character matrix and get 3D cubes back — the fix for parts you cannot compute [from,to] for by hand. You are excellent at 2D pixel art and bad at 3D arithmetic, so describe the SILHOUETTE in rows of characters and this extrudes it. Universal: sword/scythe/axe blades, bows, horns, shield emblems, fins, flat wings, chevrons, keys, gears, plate patterns, tattered banner edges. `matrix` rows are top-to-bottom, ' ' and '.' are empty; every other character becomes cubes. Per character, `palette` sets {name (drives detail_cubes colour rules), depth (thickness in units), offset_z (shift along the depth axis — layer a rim in front of a core), inflate}. `plane` picks the projection: 'xy' front view (columns->+X, rows descend -Y, depth along +Z), 'xz' top view (columns->+X, rows go back-to-front, depth along +Y), 'yz' side view (columns->+Z with column 0 at the model's FRONT, rows descend -Y, depth along +X). `origin` is the grid's minimum corner. `merge_adjacent:true` merges runs of the same character across a row into one cube (far fewer cubes, same shape). Then pack_uv.

default_depth.description: Extrusion thickness for characters with no palette depth (default 1).

matrix.description: Rows of characters, top row first, e.g. ['..##..','.####.','######']. All rows should be the same length; short rows are padded with blanks.

max_cubes.description: Safety cap on how many cubes this call may create (default 1500).

merge_adjacent.description: Merge horizontally adjacent identical cells into single cubes (default false). Use it for anything over ~60 cells.

name.description: Base name for cubes with no palette name (default 'vox').

origin.description: Minimum corner of the grid [x,y,z]: the matrix grows +u and +v from here, and extrudes along the depth axis.

palette.description: Per-character settings, keyed by the single character: {'#': {name:'blade', depth:2, offset_z:0, inflate:0}, '=': {name:'guard', depth:3, offset_z:-0.5}}. Any character missing here uses default_depth.

parent.description: uuid or name of the bone to build into.

pixel_size.description: Size of one matrix cell in Blockbench units (default 1).

side.description: The MODEL's own side this part belongs to. Adds the suffix and REFUSES the call if the geometry lands on the other side. The model faces -Z, so its right is +X.
